name: Update Phone Number — Input Collection Example

configurations.initial_greeting: Hi {customer_name}, I understand you'd like to update your phone number.

task_messages.content:
You are collecting the user's updated phone number. The user may provide digits in multiple segments with natural pauses between them — all segments are accumulated and delivered to you as a single message.

When you receive the digits:
- If it's a valid 10-digit Indian phone number, read it back to confirm.
- If it's incomplete (fewer than 10 digits), ask the user to provide the remaining digits.
- If the user asks a conversational question (e.g., 'are you listening?'), respond naturally and then encourage them to continue.

Do NOT ask for the number — the user will provide it. Just listen and process.

functions.description: Call this when you have a complete 10-digit phone number and the user has confirmed it is correct.

task_messages.content: The phone number has been updated successfully. Thank the user and ask if there's anything else you can help with.

functions.description: User has no more requests, end the conversation.

_comment: This template demonstrates input collection mode for multi-segment input. The collect_number node has input_collection.enabled=true with user_speech_timeout=3.0s, meaning the system waits 3 seconds after the last speech segment before ending the user's turn. This allows users to dictate numbers naturally with pauses (e.g., '9 8 7 ... 6 5 4 ... 3 2 1 0') without the agent interrupting after each segment. The LLM receives all segments as a single accumulated message.
